page: Zod 4 migration guide and release notes. Breaking changes listed from highest to lowest impact. Install zod@^4.0.0. Error customization APIs unified under `error` parameter replacing deprecated message, invalid_type_error, required_error, errorMap. ZodError changes: issue formats streamlined, error map precedence changed, .format() and .flatten() deprecated for z.treeifyError(), .formErrors and .errors removed, .addIssue(s) deprecated. Type-specific changes: z.number() no infinite values, .int() safe integers only, z.string() formats as top-level functions, UUID stricter, base64url no padding. z.coerce input type unknown, missing keys error. .default() short-circuits on undefined (vs Zod 3 parsing), .prefault() for pre-parse default. z.object() defaults applied in optional fields, .strict()/.passthrough() deprecated for strictObject/looseObject, .merge() deprecated for .extend(), z.unknown/any required. z.array().nonempty() type changed, z.promise() deprecated. z.function() result no longer Zod schema, uses input/output, implements/implementAsync. .refine() ignores type predicates, ctx.path removed. Release notes: 14x faster strings, 7x faster arrays, 6.5x faster objects, 100x reduction in tsc instantiations, 57% smaller bundle (Zod 4 vs 3), 85% smaller with Zod Mini. New features: metadata registries, JSON Schema conversion, recursive objects, file schemas, internationalization, template literals, number formats (int32, uint32, int64, uint64, float32, float64), stringbool, discriminated union improvements, multi-value literals, refinements in schemas, .overwrite() method.

sections.manifest: Error customization APIs unified under error parameter. Replaces message parameter (deprecated but still supported). Drops invalid_type_error and required_error - use error parameter with issue.input check instead. Drops errorMap renamed to error. Error functions can return plain string (not {message: string}), or undefined to yield to next error map. Supports error: function(issue) pattern.

ZodError issue formats streamlined. Issue subtypes: $ZodIssueInvalidType, $ZodIssueTooBig, $ZodIssueTooSmall, $ZodIssueInvalidStringFormat, $ZodIssueNotMultipleOf, $ZodIssueUnrecognizedKeys, $ZodIssueInvalidValue, $ZodIssueInvalidUnion, $ZodIssueInvalidKey (new), $ZodIssueInvalidElement (new), $ZodIssueCustom. Old types removed/merged. All issues conform to $ZodIssueBase interface. Error map precedence changed - schema-level error maps take precedence over .parse() error maps. .format() and .flatten() methods deprecated for z.treeifyError(). .formErrors removed. .errors alias removed, use .issues. .addIssue(s) deprecated, push to issues array instead.

z.number() changes: no infinite values (POSITIVE_INFINITY/NEGATIVE_INFINITY invalid), .safe() deprecated behaves like .int() no longer accepts floats, .int() accepts safe integers only within Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER range.

z.string() updates: email, uuid, url, etc. moved to top-level functions (z.email(), z.uuid(), z.url(), z.emoji(), z.base64(), z.base64url(), z.nanoid(), z.cuid(), z.cuid2(), z.ulid(), z.ipv4(), z.ipv6(), z.cidrv4(), z.cidrv6(), z.iso.date(), z.iso.time(), z.iso.datetime(), z.iso.duration()). Method forms deprecated. UUID stricter per RFC 9562/4122 (variant bits must be 10), z.guid() for permissive UUID-like. Base64url no padding no longer allowed. .ip() dropped, use separate .ipv4() and .ipv6(). .ipv6() validation via URL constructor (stricter). .cidr() dropped, use .cidrv4() and .cidrv6(). Custom email regexes: z.email({pattern: z.regexes.html5Email}), z.regexes.rfc5322Email, z.regexes.unicodeEmail.

z.coerce updates: input type now unknown (was string for coerce.string). Missing key on object with coerce field now errors - use .default() to declare fallback. Example: z.coerce.boolean() on missing key throws instead of defaulting to false.

.default() behavior changed: if input undefined, short-circuits and returns default value (must be assignable to output type). Zod 3 parsed default value against input type. z.prefault() (pre-parse default) replicates Zod 3 behavior - parses default value before returning.

z.object() changes: defaults applied within optional fields (Zod 3 had defaults not apply in optional), .strict() and .passthrough() deprecated for z.strictObject() and z.looseObject() functions, .strict() and .passthrough() remain for backwards compatibility, .strip() deprecated (was default behavior), .nonstrict() long-deprecated removed, .deepPartial() removed (deprecated in v3), z.unknown() and z.any() no longer key optional in inferred types, parse-time check added (v4.4.0+), use .optional() for key that may be absent, .merge() deprecated for .extend() (better TypeScript performance), .extend() preferred with .shape destructuring syntax.

z.nativeEnum() deprecated in favor of z.enum(). z.enum() overloaded to support enum-like input. z.enum(Color) accepts native enums. ColorSchema.enum.Red canonical API. ColorSchema.Enum and ColorSchema.Values removed.

z.array() changes: .nonempty() type changed - now behaves like .min(1) with inferred type string[] (not [string, ...string[]]). Old behavior use z.tuple([z.string()], z.string()) for [string, ...string[]] type.
z.promise() deprecated. Rarely necessary - await before parsing with Zod. z.function() removed need for z.promise() in async functions.

z.function() no longer Zod schema. Acts as standalone function factory. API changed: upfront input/output schemas instead of .args() and .returns() methods. Syntax: z.function({input: [...], output: ...}). .implement() and .implementAsync() methods for defining functions. .implementAsync() for async functions.

.refine() changes: ignores type predicates (type narrowing no longer works), drops ctx.path (not eagerly evaluated), drops function as second argument pattern. Use error parameter instead for custom messages.
z.ostring(), z.onumber(), etc. undocumented convenience methods removed.
z.literal() drops symbol support (symbols not literal values, not comparable with ===).
Static .create() factories dropped (z.ZodString.create()). Use standalone factory functions instead.

z.record() changes: drops single argument usage (z.record(z.string()) invalid), requires two arguments z.record(z.string(), z.string()). Improves enum support: z.record(z.enum(['a','b','c']), z.number()) now exhaustive {a: number; b: number; c: number} not partial. z.partialRecord() for optional keys.
z.intersection() throws regular Error on merge conflict (Zod 3 threw ZodError with invalid_intersection_types issue). Unmergable results indicate structural schema problem not validation error.

Internal changes: ZodType generics changed from <Output, Def, Input=Output> to <Output=unknown, Input=unknown>, Def generic removed. Input defaults to unknown not Output. z.ZodTypeAny eliminated, use z.ZodType. z.core subpackage added for shared utilities. ._def moved to ._zod.def. ZodEffects dropped - refinements live in schemas, stored in checks array. ZodTransform added for transforms. ZodPreprocess dropped, z.preprocess() returns ZodPipe. ZodBranded dropped, branding via direct type modification.
